title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators

paragraphs.en: AI for Science: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists
paragraphs.zh: 科学领域的 AI：AI 科学家时代的验证

paragraphs.en: Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM’s first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM’s decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.

paragraphs.en: Scientific agents operate sequentially: they propose actions, observe outcomes, and decide what to try next. Recent LLM-based systems extend this loop to hypothesis generation and refinement ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Gottweis et al., 2026 ) . As such systems run more autonomous experiments, trusting their conclusions increasingly requires checking whether their decisions respond to the evidence they collect. Once the sequence ends, a benchmark score measures overall performance but does not reveal which inputs shaped each decision.
paragraphs.zh: 科学智能体按顺序运行：它们提出行动，观察结果，并决定接下来尝试什么。 近期的基于大型语言模型的系统将这一循环扩展到了假设生成与优化（Lu 等人，2024；Gottweis 等人，2026）。 随着这类系统运行更多自主实验，信任其结论的程度日益取决于验证其决策是否对收集到的证据作出响应。 序列结束后，基准分数会衡量整体表现，但无法揭示哪些输入影响了每一项决策。

paragraphs.en: We study this distinction in a bounded experimental loop where a frozen large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations for a pretrained neural operator. The LLM adaptation policy can propose and revise configurations, but cannot alter the data, action space, trial budget, or external evaluation protocol. At each search trial, the selected configuration is executed and scored.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个有界实验循环中研究这一区别，其中，一个冻结的大型语言模型（LLM）为预训练神经算子选择微调配置。 LLM 的适配策略可以提出和修改配置，但无法更改数据、动作空间、试验预算或外部评估协议。 在每次试验中，都会执行所选配置并进行评分。

paragraphs.en: The LLM receives a natural-language description of a target partial differential equation (PDE), the history of previously evaluated configurations and validation scores, and training diagnostics. Before the first evaluation, only the problem description is available. We use cold-start prior to denote the preference induced by the LLM policy at this stage. The term refers to policy behaviour and does not imply pretrained knowledge of the underlying physics. After the first evaluation, subsequent proposals can additionally depend on validation feedback. We therefore ask whether the cold-start prior provides a useful starting point and whether later experimental outcomes causally change the policy’s actions.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型接收一个目标偏微分方程（PDE）的自然语言描述、先前评估过的配置的历史记录及其验证分数，以及训练诊断信息。 在第一次评估之前，只有问题描述是可用的。 我们使用“冷启动先验”来表示这一阶段由大语言模型策略所引导的偏好。 该术语指的是策略行为，并不意味着对底层物理原理的预训练知识。 第一次评估之后，后续的方案还可以进一步依赖验证反馈。 因此，我们需要探究：冷启动先验是否提供了一个有用的起点，以及后续的实验结果是否在因果上改变了策略的行为。

paragraphs.en: We study these questions using a pretrained Fourier neural operator (FNO), a neural operator architecture for learning solution maps between function spaces ( Li et al., 2021 ; Kovachki et al., 2023 ) . We fine-tune this FNO after the target physical regime shifts away from its pretraining distribution. Such shifts can degrade surrogate accuracy, and recent work addresses them through model scaling or broader pretraining across PDE families ( McCabe et al., 2023 ; Herde et al., 2024 ; Hao et al., 2024 ; McCabe et al., 2026 ) . We instead hold the pretrained checkpoint and target-regime data fixed and study how effectively different policies configure adaptation under a small experimental budget. This setting reflects applications in which target-regime data are costly to generate and only a limited number of fine-tuning attempts are feasible ( Carey et al., 2025 ; Luna Gutierrez et al., 2026 ) . Best practices for adapting these models remain unsettled ( Medvedev et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2026 ) , and configuring the adaptation calls for machine learning expertise that domain scientists often do not have ( Liu and Wang, 2026 ) . At each trial, a policy selects the optimiser, schedule, base learning rate, parameter-block multipliers, weight decay, rollout length, data loss, and two auxiliary physics-loss weights, then fine-tunes a fresh copy of the FNO. Model size and epochs are fixed across policies and excluded from the action space, so performance differences arise only from configuration choices. Each policy receives 20 trials to identify settings that transfer well.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一种预训练的傅里叶神经算子（FNO）来研究这些问题。FNO 是一种用于学习函数空间之间解映射的神经算子架构（Li et al., 2021; Kovachki et al., 2023）。 当目标物理机制偏离其预训练分布时，我们会对该 FNO 进行微调。 此类偏移可能会降低代理模型的准确性，近期的研究通过模型扩展或在更广泛的偏微分方程（PDE）族中进行预训练来解决这一问题（McCabe et al., 2023; Herde et al., 2024; Hao et al., 2024; McCabe et al., 2026）。 相反，我们保持预训练的检查和目标机制数据固定不变，并研究不同策略在有限的实验预算下能多有效地配置适应过程。 这种设置反映了那些目标机制数据生成成本高昂且仅能进行有限次微调尝试的应用场景（Carey et al., 2025; Luna Gutierrez et al., 2026）。 如何有效适配这些模型的最佳实践尚未确定（Medvedev et al., 2026; Song et al., 2026），而配置适配过程需要机器学习领域的专业知识，这通常是领域科学家所不具备的（Liu and Wang, 2026）。 在每次试验中，策略会选择优化器、调度方案、基础学习率、参数块乘数、权重衰减、展开长度、数据损失以及两个辅助物理损失权重，然后对 FNO 的一个新副本进行微调。 模型规模和训练轮数在所有策略中保持一致，并且不包含在动作空间中，因此性能差异仅源于配置选择的不同。 每种策略将获得 20 次试验机会，以识别能够良好迁移的设置。

paragraphs.en: We compare policies with progressively richer information. Random search uses neither problem context nor previous outcomes, whereas a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE), which handles mixed categorical and continuous spaces, models the observed configuration–score history ( Bergstra et al., 2011 ; Akiba et al., 2019 ) . The LLM receives this same history together with the PDE description and training diagnostics. All three policies operate under the same 20-trial budget, but differ in their proposal mechanisms, computational cost, and available information. Endpoint performance can therefore show whether the LLM is competitive under this budget, but not which of its additional inputs influence its decisions. This motivates the controlled input interventions below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过逐步增加信息丰富度的策略进行比较。 随机搜索既不使用问题上下文，也不使用先前结果；而能够处理混合分类和连续空间的树状帕尔泽估计器（TPE）则会建模观测到的配置-得分历史（Bergstra et al., 2011; Akiba et al., 2019）。 LLM 会接收到这一相同的历史数据，以及 PDE 描述和训练诊断信息。 这三种策略均在相同的 20 次试验预算下运行，但它们在提议机制、计算成本以及可用信息方面存在差异。 因此，最终表现可以表明 LLM 在该预算下是否具有竞争力，但无法说明其哪些额外输入影响了决策。 这促使我们在下文进行受控的输入干预。

paragraphs.en: LLMs have been used for Bayesian optimisation, from proposing configurations directly from solution–score histories to interacting with established optimisers through tools ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Mahammadli and Ertekin, 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Brunzema et al., 2026 ) . Some of these works read the effect of the problem description on search performance, whereas we also read its effect on the next proposed configuration. Recent matched comparisons show that LLM advantages are not universal: early gains can reflect default configurations, classical optimisers can outperform standalone LLM proposals, and agent gains vary across repository-level tasks ( Rodrigues et al., 2026 ; Ferreira et al., 2026 ; Huai et al., 2026 ) . No policy in our study starts from a default, so our comparison is specific to operator fine-tuning under a fixed budget.
paragraphs.zh: LLM已被用于贝叶斯优化，从直接根据解决方案-得分历史提出配置，到通过工具与成熟的优化器进行交互（Yang et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2023；Mahammadli and Ertekin, 2024；Liu et al., 2024；Agarwal et al., 2025；Brunzema et al., 2026）。 其中一些工作研究了问题描述对搜索性能的影响，而我们还研究了其对下一个所提配置的影响。 近期的匹配比较表明，LLM的优势并非普遍存在：早期的增益可能反映了默认配置，经典优化器的表现可能优于独立使用的LLM提案，而智能体的增益在不同仓库级任务中有所差异（Rodrigues et al., 2026；Ferreira et al., 2026；Huai et al., 2026）。 我们研究中的任何策略都不是从默认配置开始的，因此我们的比较仅限于在固定预算下对算子进行微调的情况。

paragraphs.en: For each trace, we replay one decision point in each of three matched windows spanning the search, measuring the action distance from the logged configuration to the regenerated proposal. The trace effect is the median intervention-minus-control difference in that distance across the three windows (Appendix B.1 ). We then take the median trace effect across three seeds to obtain one effect for each of the six cells. Windows and resamples are repeated measurements within a trace, so the test treats each cell, not each decision, as an independent unit. An exact one-sided sign-flip test over these six cell effects has a minimum attainable p p -value of 2 − 6 = 1 / 64 = 0.015625 2^{-6}=1/64=0.015625 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每条轨迹，我们在搜索过程中三个匹配的窗口中重演一个决策点，并测量已记录配置与再生提案之间的行动距离。 轨迹效应是这三个窗口中该距离的干预组与控制组差异的中位数（附录 B.1）。 接着，我们对三个种子取轨迹效应的中位数，从而得到六个单元格各自的效应值。 窗口和重采样是同一轨迹内的重复测量，因此该检验将每个单元格而非每个决策视为独立单元。 针对这六个单元格效应进行精确的单侧符号翻转检验时，可达到的最小 p 值为 2⁻⁶ = 1/64 = 0.015625。

paragraphs.en: The endpoint advantage under the fixed budget (Table 2 ) positions the LLM policy as a complement to broader operator pretraining ( McCabe et al., 2023 ; Herde et al., 2024 ; Hao et al., 2024 ; McCabe et al., 2026 ) and LLM-generated scientific solvers ( Wuwu et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Beyond endpoint performance, our verification protocol tests whether the policy uses its two distinctive inputs: the task description and observed feedback. Random search conditions on neither, while TPE conditions only on numeric history. Swapping the displayed PDE family shifts the median base learning rate of the LLM’s first proposal, while permuting scores across evaluated configurations changes its next proposal by about one categorical coordinate (Figure 2 ), primarily through rollout length and data loss. Together, these interventions show that the LLM uses the task description to form its cold-start prior and observed feedback to guide later proposals. The protocol requires only logged decision points and a distance over the action space, so it applies to hosted LLMs without access to their internals, contributing to other decision-level checks of AI agents ( Wainrib et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Yagubyan, 2026 ; Liao, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 除了端点性能之外，我们的验证协议还测试策略是否使用了其两个独特的输入：任务描述和观察到的反馈。 随机搜索不对两者施加条件，而 TPE 仅对数值历史施加条件。 切换所显示的 PDE 族会改变 LLM 首次提议的中位数基础学习率，而跨已评估配置打乱分数则会使其后续提议发生约一个分类坐标的变化（图 2），这主要影响展开长度和数据损失。 综合来看，这些干预措施表明，LLM 利用任务描述来构建其冷启动先验，并利用观察到的反馈来指导后续的提议。 该协议仅需记录的决定点和动作空间上的距离，因此适用于无法访问其内部机制的托管 LLM，这有助于对 AI 智能体进行其他决策层面的检查（Wainrib 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026；Yagubyan，2026；Liao，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Decision-level verification matters in unattended experimental loops, where two agents may reach the same endpoint score even if only one uses the evidence it gathers. The interventions therefore support a narrow conclusion: the LLM policy depends on the task description and observed scores. They do not explain why the policy responds as it does, establish that its decisions are rational or reflect physical understanding, or show that either dependence explains the endpoint advantage. Our study is limited in scope to one LLM and two one-dimensional PDE families. Applying the protocol across model families, scientific domains, higher-dimensional PDEs, and larger budgets would test whether these sensitivities generalise and help the agent select better solutions.

paragraphs.en: Prior or feedback? In this fixed-budget adaptation loop, the LLM policy uses both: it starts from a useful prior shaped by the task description and adjusts its later decisions in response to feedback. sents.en: The semigroup proxy feeds the FNO its own one-step prediction back as input and penalises ∥ f ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( u t ) ) − u t + 2 ∥ 2 \lVert f(f(u_{t}))-u_{t+2}\rVert^{2} against the field two steps ahead.
sents.zh: 半群代理将 FNO 自身的一步预测结果作为输入反馈，并惩罚 ∥ f ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( u t ) ) − u t + 2 ∥ 2 \lVert f(f(u_{t}))-u_{t+2}\rVert^{2} 与两个步骤后的场之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: The FNO is divided into four parameter blocks: lift, spectral, bypass, and projection. Each carries its own learning rate η block = η base ​ m block \eta_{\mathrm{block}}=\eta_{\mathrm{base}}m_{\mathrm{block}} , so a configuration sets one base rate and four multipliers rather than four independent rates. Random search and TPE sample the base learning rate and the four multipliers log-uniformly over the bounds in Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: FNO 分为四个参数块：升力块、谱块、旁通块和投影块。 每个参数块都有自己的学习率 η 块 = η_base × m_block，因此一种配置只需设置一个基础学习率和四个乘数，而不是四个独立的学习率。 随机搜索和 TPE 在表 3 中的边界范围内以对数均匀分布的方式采样基础学习率和这四个乘数。

paragraphs.en: Both controls are defined against prompt resampling, to account for the sampling variance of LLM generations. The notation control preserves every score and its assignment while changing the characters, and the cross-family control resamples from an identical prompt, so a gap measured against either exceeds what repeated sampling alone produces.
paragraphs.zh: 两种控制方法都针对提示词重采样进行了定义，以考虑大型语言模型生成过程中的采样方差。 符号控制方法在改变字符的同时保留每个分数及其分配，而跨家族控制方法则从相同的提示词中进行重采样，因此与这两种控制方法之一相比所测得的差异，会超过仅通过重复采样所产生的差异。

paragraphs.en: The statistic is the median log 10 \log_{10} base learning rate per displayed description, pooling the 45 proposals from each target cell. paragraphs.en: The main comparison uses five startup trials, below Optuna’s default of ten. This control restores the default in one within-family and one cross-family cell, with three seeds each.
